newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ColMut to buy Jardine j/v - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ColMut to buy Jardine j/v - paper.

text.p: Australian-based insurance and banking group Colonial Mutual Group (CMG) would pay more than A$200 million to buy out its joint venture partner in the Asian region, Jardine Pacific Holdings, The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Friday.
Jardine Pacific is a subsidiary of Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd.
"Sources in Hong Kong revealed that the joint venture company, Jardine-CMG Life Holdings, would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Colonial under the deal," the Herald said.
Jardine-CMG owns life businesses in Hong Kong, the Philippines and Singapore.
"It is believed details of the purchase will be announced in Hong Kong next week by the (Colonial Mutual) group's managing director Peter Smedley," the newspaper said.
Colonial Mutual, which currently has a mutual structure, is due to demutualise and list on the stock exchange in the first half of this year.
The group plans to distribute A$1.3 billion in shares to its 538,000 members worldwide, and raise another A$550 million, as part of its demutualisation and listing.
